intent: Generated and accepted original artwork for ten new balance and strategy cards; this per-batch manifest preserves prompts, source hashes, and review sizes.
shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE Rootward fantasy programming roguelite card icon. Style: polished high-resolution fantasy pixel art matching the finished bronze-and-jewel icons. Bold dark plum contours, rich bronze fittings, broad cyan, amber, and violet crystal planes, restrained ivory highlights, crisp stepped edges, and large readable clusters. Render at 1254 by 1254 pixels with roughly 128-pixel detail density, not as an enlarged crude low-resolution placeholder. Compact square composition; one centered subject filling about 82 percent of the width and height, with genuine transparent alpha margins.
